name: CosmoLex
description: CosmoLex is cloud legal practice-management software for matter management, calendaring, tasks, documents, time and expense tracking, billing, payments, trust accounting, business accounting, client portal workflows, and legal reporting.
agentUseSummary: CosmoLex is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Official public CosmoLex materials describe the legal-practice product, built-in app integrations, and May 2026 newsletter language about open API options, but do not publish the concrete public developer contract Relay needs: authorization model, base URL, scopes, endpoint semantics, rate limits, test tenant, partner enrollment, or production acceptance terms. Relay will not collect accounts, credentials, firm data, trust or payment data, or use browser sessions, Zapier, LexShare, or other third-party integrations as a substitute for a CosmoLex API contract.

capabilities.label: Coordinate legal practice and accounting operations
capabilities.description: Preview a future provider-approved, exact-firm-authorized, least-privilege integration surface without assuming access to identity, client, matter, document, payment, trust, or accounting records.

blocked.label: Connect without a CosmoLex API contract
blocked.description: Relay will not accept or mint credentials until CosmoLex supplies or approves the exact authorization model, production and test origins, scopes or permissions, tenant binding, token lifecycle, rate limits, audit requirements, and live acceptance process.

blocked.label: Access identity, client, matter, or accounting records
blocked.description: Users, firms, roles, clients, contacts, matters, custom fields, ledger entries, chart-of-accounts data, trust accounting, business accounting, bank records, reports, and related legal-practice records remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Access financial, payment, trust, or document data
blocked.description: Time entries, expenses, invoices, billing, payments, retainers, trust transfers, accounting exports, documents, folders, calendar entries, tasks, notes, emails, client portal content, and communications remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw APIs, UI sessions, or third-party integrations
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, undocumented APIs, browser sessions, cookies, passwords, traffic capture, Zapier flows, LexShare keys, calendar/email/document integrations, scraping, reverse engineering, pagination, polling, bulk operations, exports, writes, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider and firm review required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until CosmoLex supplies or approves the public API and production integration contract, and the exact law firm authorizes a least-privilege connection.

runtimeSupport.description: CosmoLex remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable before CosmoLex approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.
CosmoLex remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable before CosmoLex approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.

providerSetup.blocker: CosmoLex public materials document product integrations and mention open API options, but the reviewed first-party materials do not publish the complete third-party API contract Relay requires for implementation: enrollment, authorization model, base URL, scopes or permissions, token and revocation lifecycle, endpoint schemas, rate limits, test tenant, audit requirements, or production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask CosmoLex to approve Relay and provide the current public or partner API contract, production and test origins, authorization and callback model, scopes or tenant permissions, token lifecycle, rate limits, audit and privacy obligations, test tenant, and live acceptance process. Then obtain explicit authorization from the exact law firm and approve a least-privilege action/data classification before implementing any connector.

evidence.supports: CosmoLex describes integrations for email, calendar, document management, billing, payments, client portal, accounting, and legal-practice workflows, establishing product scope but not a public Relay-callable API contract.

CosmoLex support lists built-in app integrations across email forwarding, document storage, calendar sync, billing, payments, Zapier, and CRM, but does not publish API authentication, endpoints, scopes, rate limits, or production acceptance.
CosmoLex's May 2026 newsletter mentions open API options, but the public article does not provide the API contract or authorization details needed for Relay implementation.

CosmoLex setup guidance references clients, matters, time and expenses, trust transactions, billing, reports, users, roles, and documents, confirming sensitive legal and accounting data classes that remain blocked.

securityNotes: No CosmoLex account, API key, token, firm identifier, client, matter, document, payment, trust, accounting, or legal-practice data was collected or tested.
A public mention of open API options does not establish Relay authorization, a distributable authentication flow, exact tenant binding, least-privilege scopes, or production acceptance.

Relay will not use browser sessions, passwords, cookies, provider consoles, Zapier, LexShare, email/calendar/document integrations, traffic capture, scraping, or reverse engineering as a substitute for a CosmoLex API contract.

All identity, client, contact, matter, document, calendar, task, communication, time, billing, payment, trust, accounting, reporting, write, administration, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export operations remain unavailable.
